frame_review.observed: Woman seated on the edge of a bed with a man standing further back and turned away; both figures sit below four tenths of the frame.

relevance_reason: Two people at a distance from each other: the loss of chemistry and trust this beat names.
selection_reason: The separation between the two figures carries the beat; both sit below the upper band, which is plain wall.
